notes_for_editor: Only Tennessee Landforms places a Cliff Top tower in the park, and its entry is one line with no build, design or removal date. No source found gives those for Cliff Top; the park-wide facts come from the Clemson thesis and two articles. The Tennessee Landforms per-tower pages (m.php) are filled with injected gambling-site text, so only its /towers/ table was used. The Hiking Project Cliff Top viewpoint is not confirmed as the tower site. Sources disagree on Cove Mountain: The Mountain Press counts its tower as standing, while Smoky Mountain Living says the site is now an air-quality monitoring station (not used in the story). Brief status and access fields stay as they were; the brief elevation of 1998.0 m matches the 6555 ft entry.
